name: adv_asr_ctc_clean
title: CTC speech recognition, correct - and the log_softmax trap
note: The trap this program exists for is the log-softmax. `nn.CTCLoss` REQUIRES log-probabilities as its first argument - unlike CrossEntropyLoss, which log-softmaxes internally - so `F.log_softmax(...)` feeding `criterion(...)` at lines 108-111 is the documented, correct pairing and MLV401 firing on it would be a false positive on textbook code. It carries no `expected` row and must carry no finding. MLView measures 39 nodes / 49 edges, reports zero findings, and declares one `untagged_dataflow` coverage gap (the two LIBRISPEECH datasets carry no tag, because torchaudio has no knowledge row).

forbidden.why: the loss is nn.CTCLoss, not CrossEntropyLoss, and CTCLoss's documented contract is that its first argument is already log-probabilities; the F.log_softmax at line 108 is required, not a double log-softmax
the training loader is built with shuffle=True at line 83
the dev loader is built with shuffle=False at line 85
the module has an `if __name__ == "__main__": main()` guard at line 155 and every loader is built inside build_loaders(), which only main() calls
train_epoch calls optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) at line 105, before the forward
optimizer.step() is called at line 114
the order is zero_grad (105) -> backward (112) -> clip (113) -> step (114)
the only no_grad is the @torch.no_grad() decorator on greedy_decode() at line 121; the backward is in train_epoch
train_epoch accumulates loss.item() at line 116, never the tensor
OneCycleLR is a per-batch schedule and scheduler.step() is called once per batch at line 115, which is the correct cadence
clip_grad_norm_ at line 113 sits between backward (112) and step (114), which is the correct position
greedy_decode() calls model.eval() at line 123 and features.eval() at line 124; train_epoch restores model.train() at line 98
greedy_decode() carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator at line 121
DEVICE is chosen by torch.cuda.is_available() at line 29
seed_everything() at line 32 seeds random, numpy and torch
there is no split call; train-clean-100 and dev-clean are two separate LibriSpeech downloads
TrainFeatures, EvalFeatures and Acoustic all call super().__init__() on their first line
the two SpecAugment transforms are held in nn.Sequential at line 45
torch.save writes model.state_dict() at line 152
TrainFeatures carries the SpecAugment masks and EvalFeatures does not; the evaluation branch is a pure mel front-end

unsupported.defect: none - the log_softmax feeding CTCLoss is the documented, correct pairing
unsupported.why: recorded so the absence is deliberate: MLV403 (NLLLoss without a preceding log_softmax) is a later-tier rule that is not built, so it cannot be a `forbidden` row. The day it ships it must not fire here, and it must not fire in the inverse direction on the twin either.
